_README: Routine template for the Workout Tracker.
1. Copy this file and edit the routine(s) below.
2. In the app: Programme -> Manage routines -> Import routines, and pick your file.
3. Importing ADDS routines; it never overwrites your history or existing routines.
Field notes:
name      (required) routine title
days[]    (required) one entry per workout day
code      short label shown on the day button (A, B, X1, Legs ...)
focus     day name, e.g. 'Push'
color     hex accent for the day, e.g. '#FF6B2C'
muscles   subtitle line (free text)
duration  e.g. '~45 min'
express   true = shown in the Express section (occasional faster session)
exercises[]
name      (required) EXACT name; reuse the same spelling across routines so progress/PRs carry over
sets      number of sets
reps      free text, e.g. '8-10' or '45 sec'
rest      rest in seconds (number)
equipment free text. Include the word 'Dumbbells' (plural) for two-dumbbell lifts so the weight picker uses the dumbbell stack and the x2 total
superset  (optional) EXACT name of the partner exercise to pair as a superset
cues      (optional) coaching cues
why       (optional) rationale shown under the exercise
Any 'id' you set is ignored on import (a fresh one is generated) so you can import the same file repeatedly.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.cues: Control the lowering phase. Full range of motion.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cues: Sit tall, pull elbows past the torso, pause at the peak.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cues: Chest tall, squat to depth, drive through the heels.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cues: Hinge at the hips, soft knees, neutral spine.
